architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero backend changes of any kind - confirmed by an empty Rust diff and this rebuild's own zero-new-symbol result.

Bible/Sermon/Service/Music detection are architecturally incapable of being affected by this toggle - they are driven entirely by the backend speech worker, which has no dependency on frontend rendering state.
Every prior-phase command and Phase 14/15 symbol remains present and unregressed, confirming this phase's addition did not disturb any prior gate or feature.
